definitions.explanation: A question or set of questions used to test knowledge, often in an entertaining format. In Japanese, クイズ often refers to trivia-style questions rather than formal tests.

examples.japanese: クイズ{番組|ばんぐみ}を{見|み}るのが{好|す}きだ。
{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}でクイズ{大会|たいかい}をやったら、{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: We held a quiz competition at the year-end party and it was a hit.

notes:
USAGE:
クイズ in Japanese usage leans toward entertainment-style trivia rather than academic testing. Quiz shows (クイズ{番組|ばんぐみ}) are a staple of Japanese television. For classroom tests, テスト or {試験|しけん} is used instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- クイズ{番組|ばんぐみ}: quiz show
- クイズ{大会|たいかい}: quiz competition
- クイズを{出|だ}す: to give a quiz question
- クイズに{正解|せいかい}する: to answer a quiz correctly
